legend_notes: Two layers share these lanes: L1 = upstream graphiti_core, L2 = this repo's MCP wrapper servers/graphiti/server.py. The wrapper owns A1, B5 and B6.
The paper's per-entity LLM loop is not what runs. Entity resolution is one batch call for all unresolved nodes, and summaries go 30 at a time — measured llm_calls = 3 per session, flat.
The engine ships its own χ (search_helpers.py:28) but search_() never calls it, so the wrapper rebuilt one. B6 therefore has two nodes: the one that runs and the one that exists.
Communities never form on the ingest path: update_communities defaults to False and build_communities() is a manual MCP tool. All 105 measured retrieves returned 0 communities.
